title: Reminder sends have no time limit, so one hung send keeps the run going and blocks reminders on that machine until a restart (a Sentry warning after 6 h)
evidence: app/lib/reminder-v2-cron.server.ts: each send's Resend request carries an AbortController signal fired after SEND_TIMEOUT_MS (30 s); email.server.ts sendReminderEmail passes it to emails.send, whose fetch is aborted; the SDK reports the abort as an error, so the send returns false: email-send-failed as today, no last_sent, the day-stamp stands. The pass ends and the lock row ends finished. Test failing first: reminder-v2-send-deadline.test.ts (real cron, lock, email.server and Resend SDK, fetch stubbed, fake timers). US-23 AC16
